after.content:
& scp -q -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $key $archive "${target}:ji-stage6-release/source.tar.gz"
    $localStandalone = Join-Path $root "ji-java\products\ji-standalone\build\distributions\ji-standalone-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-windows-10-amd64-java21.tar.gz"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $localStandalone -PathType Leaf)) { throw "local standalone archive is unavailable" }
    & ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $key $target @'
set -eu
root=$HOME/ji-stage6-release
